card.name: Digits just before units like mL or watt
card.fires_on: Mostly the digit or letter inside a number right before a measurement unit such as mL/min, ml, watt or ULN. Also seen inside a few other words, like the start of a drug name or PaO2.

modes.label: Digit before unit
modes.description: A digit in a number that is directly followed by a unit such as mL, mL/min or watt.

modes.label: Multiplier or unit letter
modes.description: The x in a multiple of the upper limit of normal, or the m of mL in a unit label.

modes.label: Start of a name
modes.description: The cl or Pa piece at the start of a drug name or blood gas term.

card.writes: It promotes consonant starts like ph, kh and cl and suppresses q, so it has no clear link to the number-and-unit pattern.
